title: Enriching Abusive Language Detection with Community Context

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the false positive rate of abusive language classifiers on non-derogatory and appropriative uses of racial slurs (e.g., African-American Vernacular English) using the Slur-Corpus.
Measuring the misclassification of reclaimed homophobic slurs in LGBTQ+ community contexts by comparing the false positive rates of context-sensitive and context-insensitive toxicity models.
Assessing the false positive rate of toxicity classifiers on non-derogatory uses of transphobic slurs within supportive transgender community subreddits.
